name: Daily trend scalp: path × direction, 1-3 trades of 10-30 points
why: On a day whose path since the open is straight, the side of the open is where the day's order flow is; joining it for a fixed 10-30 points, up to three times, harvests that drift in small pieces. Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_trend_scalp.md).

scan.when: ((abs(px-open)/max(hod-lod, 1)) >= 0.55 && abs(px-open) >= 0.15*atr && sign(px-open)*(px - vwap) > 0) && ((e == 0) + (e == 1)*((sign(px-open) > 0 && lo(5,1) <= vwap + 0.05*atr && cl(5,1) > vwap) || (sign(px-open) < 0 && hi(5,1) >= vwap - 0.05*atr && cl(5,1) < vwap)) + (e == 2)*((sign(px-open) > 0 && lo(5,1) <= ema(5,20) && cl(5,1) > ema(5,20)) || (sign(px-open) < 0 && hi(5,1) >= ema(5,20) && cl(5,1) < ema(5,20)))) > 0
